div.p: Treatment conversion rose from 8.2% in week 1 to 9.8% in week 4; the control moved from 8.0% to 8.5%. The treatment distribution is higher across this sample, with all three cohort checks inside the quality guardrail. Continue only as a limited rollout because these four weeks do not establish long-term retention.
